headline: Orderly overnight Nasdaq setup ahead of U.S. labor and manufacturing data
body: Long Treasury yields have eased after expanded U.S. Treasury buybacks and risk assets are firmer, while Brent and constrained Strait of Hormuz traffic keep cross-asset Stress elevated.
